CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to any identified content was present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an explicit organization statement (coordinate orientation), and a distinct origin/status entry are present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified contents' presentation/access; operation/origin labels alone do not qualify.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (color labels) with associated position sets are present.

D.rationale: The text separately records an origin/status field alongside the identified content for the same referent/time, distinguishing content identity from its record status.

O.rationale: An explicit statement describes how coordinates are organized/presented, which grounds presentation organization for the listed content.
